scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。 本次覆盖提示：精选8篇；arXiv占100%，来源多样性未达标，未入选中文来源。

papers.title: BoundaryMORPH: Budgeted Reranking via Active Set Selection for Diffuse Retrieval
papers.authors: Eylon Caplan, Shamik Roy, Shib Sankar Dasgupta, Yingfan Wang, Rashmi Gangadharaiah
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27213v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Open-ended queries in modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) are increasingly "diffuse," requiring a large set of documents to be assembled into a finite LLM context window. To ensure retrieval quality, systems use fast dual-encoders and more expensive cross-encoders (CEs) to score candidates. However, the CE budget $B$ is strictly bounded by latency and is often smaller than the context window capacity $k$. This mismatch makes standard reranking structurally flawed: it wastes compute verifying obvious top candidates while ignoring relevant documents further down the initial ranking. To address this, we introduce BoundaryMORPH, a novel algorithm that allocates CE budget specifically for the LLM's context capacity $k$. Using a Gaussian Process, BoundaryMORPH treats the initial dual-encoder ranking as a structural prior and intelligently spends CE calls on resolving top-$k$ set membership at the boundary, rather than seeking a single
papers.summary: 针对重排预算小于最终候选集合的问题，BoundaryMORPH 用高斯过程传播已评分文档的信息，并把计算集中在 top-k 集合边界。NeuCLIR 上预算为 25 次时，nCG@100 从 BAGEL 的 51.4 提高到 55.1；Robust04 同设置从 41.0 提高到 46.4。该结果衡量集合覆盖质量，不等同于首屏排序收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的宽泛意图往往需要覆盖多个子话题，可以借鉴按入选不确定性分配重排预算的设计。先固定召回池、调用次数和最终集合大小，与常规前缀重排比较覆盖率及 nDCG，再评估高斯过程的额外延迟；论文的集合指标不能直接推导线上 CTR。

papers.title: ItColBERT: An Italian-Specialised Late-Interaction Retriever
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26856v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Neural information retrieval for Italian is served almost entirely by multilingual models. Several multi-vector (late-interaction) retrievers include Italian among dozens of languages, and several strong Italian dense embedders exist, but as of August 2026 no late-interaction retriever specialised on Italian had been released. We present ItColBERT, a 135M-parameter Italian ColBERT trained with PyLate following the ColBERT-Zero recipe: initialise from a checkpoint that already retrieves, then apply supervised contrastive training followed by single-teacher distillation, for a total of roughly 14.5 GPU-hours on one RTX 3090. Across four Italian retrieval benchmarks it outperforms every general-purpose late-interaction baseline we tested except one (mLateOn), at 2-4.4x fewer parameters than every baseline but one of comparable size. Our principal empirical finding is methodological and partly negative. On the only cleanly out-of-domain benc
papers.summary: ItColBERT 将已有检索检查点适配为 1.35 亿参数的意大利语多向量检索器，在单张 RTX 3090 上训练约 14.5 小时。四个基准的比较显示，域外 MLDR-it 仅调整推理分块就带来 0.0602 的 nDCG@10 增量，超过额外两轮训练的收益；自挖难负样本和长序列训练均未通过预设决策门槛。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴的重点是把低成本推理调整与再训练放在同一评测协议下，而不是直接迁移意大利语权重。社区帖子可按长短文本分别验证分块与聚合，并用配对检验区分真实增益和噪声；作者测得的 0.0030 噪声下限只属于其评测设置，不能直接沿用到中文 UGC。

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation with Query-Dependent Residuals for Visual Document Retrieval
papers.authors: Zeliang Li, Xiaofen Xing, Kailing Guo, Xiangmin Xu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27688v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Visual document retrieval (VDR) systems depend on page embeddings computed before deployment, which makes adaptation difficult when encoder parameters or corpus re-encoding are unavailable. Rerankers provide useful relevance signals, but conventional reranking applies them only to selected queries and candidate pages. We introduce Q-REACT, a query-side test-time adaptation method that converts limited reranker feedback into reusable retrieval improvements. Q-REACT learns a shared low-rank transformation that produces query-dependent residuals, combines adapted query scores with document-level context, and distills reranker preferences with a student distribution normalized over the complete task-specific page index. This design lets unscored pages compete through cached embeddings while keeping the encoders and page index fixed. Across eight ViDoRe V3 tasks and five open-weight and proprietary backbones, Q-REACT improves average retrieva
papers.summary: Q-REACT 固定文档向量与编码器，用低秩变换学习查询相关残差，并在完整页面索引上归一化蒸馏目标。ViDoRe V3 的八个任务、五个骨干中，仅使用 145 个查询反馈时，任务模式平均 nDCG@10 从 54.73 到 56.61；完整反馈时达到 62.61，对应直接重排为 60.25，指标均按百分制报告。
papers.key_insight: 这项工作适合启发索引更新昂贵的社区图文搜索：把少量重排信号沉淀为可复用的查询侧适配，而非只调整当前请求的候选顺序。落地应先做未见查询与跨话题验证，区分反馈覆盖与泛化收益，再检查全索引归一化和低秩适配的成本；视觉页面结果仍需在短文本语料上重新验证。

papers.title: WARP: Wasserstein-Aligned RAG for Population Opinions
papers.authors: Aman Singh Thakur, Aditya Agrawal, Alwarappan Nakkiran, Alex Karlsson
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2608.22859v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: RAG systems are increasingly used to summarize what large collections of documents say. A user asks "What do people think about X?" and receives an answer that reads as consensus. But standard top-k retrieval ranks documents by query similarity, not by how faithfully they represent the population, so minority views quietly disappear. Existing fixes fall short. Diversity re-rankers like MMR and DPP spread retrieved documents apart, but with no target distribution to aim for. Calibration methods based on KL or JS divergence do target one, yet treat opinion bins as unordered: confusing strong positive with strong negative costs no more than an adjacent-bin miss.
  We introduce WARP, a family of post-retrieval algorithms that calibrate retrieved evidence to the population's opinion distribution. WARP first recovers underrepresented opinions that cosine ranking may bury, then uses Wasserstein-1 distance to select documents whose sentiment
papers.summary: WARP 面向评论观点检索，先找回被相似度排序掩盖的少数观点，再用 Wasserstein-1 距离让入选集合贴近总体情绪分布。三个评论领域包含 3.5 万文档、156 个查询和 26 个实体，适配领域的变体将分布误差至少降低 43%，延迟低于一秒；在 k≤5 的已判定比较中，五个 LLM 裁判对其答案偏好率为 86%。
papers.key_insight: 当社区用户搜索某产品口碑时，单纯追求相关性可能把高频立场误写成共识，可以在相关候选池上增加观点分布约束。试验前需要定义总体样本、情绪强度标签和最低相关性门槛，并把分布误差与 nDCG、CTR 分开监控；LLM 裁判偏好也不能替代真实用户的点击或满意度证据。

papers.title: When Learned Context Planning Fails to Beat Strong Retrieval: A Controlled Study of Planning, Routing, and Reranking for Long-Context QA
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26976v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Learned context planning selects evidence atoms before an answer model reasons over them. We test whether this learned selection improves long-context multiple-choice QA after strong retrieval, routing, budgeted-selector, and reranking controls. Our primary diagnostic uses all 503 LongBench-v2 MCQ questions with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. The planner is SFT-trained on outcome-selected traces from 140 training and 28 development questions; because the 503-question analysis includes those questions, it is partly transductive. At an 18k-character budget, anchored hybrid retrieval reaches 36.18% accuracy and BM25 reaches 35.98%, while the best direct planner-guided method reaches 34.19%. On the untouched 152-question test split, anchored hybrid remains higher (42.11% versus 36.84%). Leakage-safe routers cannot convert a large oracle gap. Under tight budgets, the best planner is ahead by only 0.40 points at 6k and loses at 9k; planner-guided rera
papers.summary: 该研究在 LongBench-v2 上比较学习式上下文规划与强检索基线。503 题、1.8 万字符预算下，锚定混合检索准确率为 36.18%，BM25 为 35.98%，最佳直接规划方法为 34.19%；独立的 152 题测试集上，混合检索仍以 42.11% 高于规划的 36.84%，说明复杂选择器未稳定超越检索。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索接入问答的场景，先把混合召回、证据预算和拼接顺序控制好，再比较学习式规划是否提供额外价值。论文明确指出全量分析部分包含训练题，因此应优先参考独立测试集；重排在小预算下的收益区间跨零，也提醒团队不要把单次离线提升作为上线复杂模块的充分依据。

papers.title: MultiVENT-Raw: A Benchmark for Retrieval and Reasoning over Raw Videos
papers.authors: Reno Kriz, David Etter, Alexander Martin, Cameron Carpenter, Debashish Chakraborty, Hannah Recknor, Reihaneh Iranmanesh, Matthew Maciejewski, Kenton Murray, Eugene Yang, Benjamin Van Durme, Aaron Steven White, Andrew Yates, William Walden
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.28437v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Online information is increasingly consumed in video format. Much of this comes in the form of *raw video*: continuous footage taken on a cell phone, with a hand-held camera, or via CCTV, which is then directly uploaded to social media platforms and content sharing services. Whereas professional or even amateur-edited footage tends to feature scripted speech, chyrons, graphics, and metadata that help contextualize its subject matter, raw video typically contains none of these things, making it a much more challenging medium for information retrieval and machine understanding. To facilitate progress in this domain, we release MultiVENT-Raw, a multilingual collection of nearly 120,000 primarily raw videos (over 5,300 total hours), paired with 130 events and 222 event-centric queries, along with human-annotated video relevance judgments and human-extracted key facts for relevant videos. MultiVENT-Raw supports both a retrieval task---to id
papers.summary: MultiVENT-Raw 为缺少字幕和编辑线索的原始视频建立多语言检索基准，包含 118802 个视频、5351 小时内容、130 个事件与 222 个查询。Full 集合上，OmniEmbed-mv 的 nDCG@10 为 47.2，接 Gemma 4 重排后为 51.5；通用 Qwen3-VL 基线为 26.7，说明领域适配对原始视频召回十分重要。
papers.key_insight: 如果社区搜索要覆盖用户直接上传的现场视频，可借鉴同时保留原始片段和语义相似的剪辑视频作为困难负例。其 Full 与 Core 拆分有助于识别模型是否偏爱带字幕的内容，评测时应把文本、图像和视频召回分桶；对目前以短文本为主的业务，这更适合作为扩展基准而非直接替换现有召回。

papers.title: Distilling Lexical Product Associations into Deep Transformers: An Extreme Multi-Label Approach for Natural Language E-Commerce Search
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26921v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Traditional e-commerce search platforms rely heavily on inverted indices and token-level lexical matching algorithms (e.g., BM25 and TF-IDF), which frequently fail on conversational, intent-driven, or paraphrased user queries -- the classic vocabulary mismatch problem. We formulate conversational product recommendation as an Extreme Multi-Label Classification (XMLC) problem over an e-commerce catalog of N = 54,000 products spanning 27 balanced retail categories from the Amazon Reviews '23 benchmark. Using a pre-trained DistilBERT transformer encoder, we distill dense item-to-item similarity topologies (generated via TF-IDF cosine similarity over cumulative metadata with K = 50 nearest neighbours) into a deep contextual representation via a pseudo-label knowledge distillation framework.
  Evaluated on an exact 85/15 train/validation split (8,089 held-out products across C = 53,923 output classes) with strict self-exclusion enforced, the D
papers.summary: 论文把电商自然语言检索建模为极端多标签分类，将 TF-IDF 的 50 个近邻伪标签蒸馏给 DistilBERT。对约 5.4 万商品、8089 个留出样本，学生 NDCG@10 为 0.8845，教师为 0.9419；学生 P@1 为 93.15%，低于教师的 98.10%。自然语言意图泛化主要依赖十类查询的定性展示。
papers.key_insight: 词法教师提供廉价训练信号的思路可用于社区短文本检索冷启动，但商品关联复现成绩不能当作真实查询相关性成绩。建议保留独立人工标注查询集，专门测口语改写与否定约束；同时评估帖子持续新增时分类输出层的维护成本，双塔迁移在文中属于部署方向而非已经验证的生产结论。

papers.title: EidosDoc: Implicit Structure Encoding for Cost-Effective Semi-Structured Document QA
papers.authors: Teng Lin, Yuyu Luo, Nan Tang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27784v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Semi-structured documents are ubiquitous in scientific reports, financial statements, and technical manuals. Question answering over such documents requires simultaneous understanding of text, tables, charts, and complex hierarchical layouts. Existing methods either rely on repeatedly calling large language models for structure parsing and retrieval, leading to high cost and large latency, or they flatten the document and lose layout and hierarchy information, sacrificing answer accuracy. To address this, we propose EidosDoc, a novel system that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with minimal computational expense. Our approach introduces three core innovations. (1) An Implicit Structure Encoder trained via contrastive learning and a structure consistency loss. This module jointly embeds hierarchical relationships, spatial positions, and textual content into a dense vector space, capturing document structure holistically without the need
papers.summary: EidosDoc 用对比学习和结构一致性损失编码文档的层次、位置与文字，再结合 BM25、布局指纹和轻量交叉编码器检索。作者在四个半结构化文档问答基准上报告达到最佳准确率，同时相对前序最佳方法成本降低 50 倍、延迟降低 4 倍；这些是摘要报告的总体结果，当前未核验逐任务指标。
papers.key_insight: 社区长帖中的标题、正文、表格和评论引用关系可参考这种结构表征，尤其适用于纯文本展开后信息丢失的问题。需要先判断 UGC 是否具备稳定的结构信号，再对照普通分块与混合检索做消融；文档问答上的成本倍数不能照搬到帖子搜索，且首次提交日期应按原始页面记录为八月。
